name: research
description: Parallel research, critique, and synthesis team
instructions: Share evidence with explicit absolute agent paths. Keep messages concise and source-grounded. The synthesizer owns the final integrated recommendation.

members.name: researcher
members.task: Investigate the objective deeply: {{task}}. Gather concrete evidence, send your strongest findings to /root/synthesizer with team_followup_task so late evidence reactivates the synthesizer even if it is already IDLE, and finish with team_report.

members.name: critic
members.task: Independently challenge assumptions, risks, and missing evidence for: {{task}}. Send your most important corrections and gaps to /root/synthesizer with team_followup_task so late critiques reactivate the synthesizer even if it is already IDLE, and finish with team_report.

members.name: synthesizer
members.task: Own the synthesis for: {{task}}. Do NOT occupy an execution slot in a long team_wait; quickly inspect any already-delivered evidence and finish your initial turn cleanly (call team_report with dropped if waiting on initial researcher/critic deliveries) so team_followup_task from /root/researcher and /root/critic reactivates this session with their findings. Once woken with evidence, integrate findings, resolve disagreements from source-grounded evidence, and report the final synthesis to your parent.
